# Thu vien tai lieu tren Docs site

Trang chu docs mo ta Enterprise Chatbot AI va cac duong vao chinh: Catalog, Roadmap, Publish Guide.
Danh muc Catalog lien ket toi cac nhom 01 Overview den 08 Marketing va muc 99 Other.
Roadmap theo vai tro tom tat duong di cho Sales, PM, Technical va Operations.

# Preview va publish tai lieu

Chay `mkdocs serve` de xem truoc tai lieu tai may local.
Publish len GitHub Pages theo huong dan trong publish guide: build `site/` roi day len nhanh `gh-pages` hoac tuong duong.
Sau khi doi noi dung markdown, nen chay `mkdocs build` de kiem tra loi truoc khi merge.
